$comment: BES fleet guardrails for GitHub Copilot CLI. TEMPLATE — @@FLEET_ROOTS@@ is substituted at install time with this machine's fleet repo roots. Canonical source: agents/copilot-hooks/bes-fleet.json; install with agents/scripts/install-copilot-hooks.sh. USER-LEVEL by necessity: repo-level .github/hooks/*.json does not load on CLI 1.0.78 (measured), so this cannot travel via fleet-sync.sh and is per-machine setup. TRUST BOUNDARY: these hooks are machine-wide, so membership is decided by an explicit ROOT ALLOWLIST, never by a file existing — presence-only guarding let an untrusted repo's .claude/hooks script execute (cross-family review, 2026-08-06). The root is resolved with git rev-parse so a session started in a subdirectory is still gated. PascalCase events deliver Claude's payload and matcher semantics, so the scripts run unmodified; preToolUse is fail-closed on exit 2. Authority: specs/2026-08-06-copilot-guardrail-parity/SPEC.md

SessionStart.bash: root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ -n "$root" ] || exit 0; case "$root" in @@FLEET_ROOTS@@) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; [ -f "$root/.claude/hooks/session-start-context.sh" ] || exit 0; CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$root" bash "$root/.claude/hooks/session-start-context.sh"
